load_silhouettes_dataset: load the Caltech101 silhouettes dataset from .mat files and return metadata and split generators
generate_split_images: generate PIL Image and label pairs from a train, val, or test split of the silhouettes dataset
create_class_to_label_map: build a class name to integer label mapping from the silhouettes dataset class names
use_silhouettes_16_dataset: use the silhouettes_16 DownloadableDataset to download and process 16x16 Caltech101 silhouette images
use_silhouettes_28_dataset: use the silhouettes_28 DownloadableDataset to download and process 28x28 Caltech101 silhouette images
